Spacing step; omitted takes the theme padding (--card-padding), step 4 without a theme. The axis and edge attributes of BoxPropsMixin are additions.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host, `::part(base)` or the documented attributes.
The element itself is the handle; the box is reachable as part "base".

differences.text: Default variant: 1px --color-border rule, --radius-container corners, --color-background-card fill and padding step 4, with the border drawn inside the padding; no drop-shadow at rest (tecton-astryx components.ts `Surfaces`: the Tecton panel is flat, card and section are not theme targets).

The host carries the sizes and an inner part="base" paints the card. Card also accepts the padding axis and edge attributes of BoxPropsMixin (upstream has only `padding`), and publishes its padding as --container-padding-* and --layout-padding-* for bleeding descendants and layout components.
In forced-colors mode the card keeps a ButtonBorder edge (backgrounds and shadows are dropped there), with the padding compensated so border plus padding still equals the padding asked for.

The padding custom properties (`--card-padding*` / `--section-padding*`) are the WC form of the documented themed padding (`derived: padding, expand: container`); private steps propagate through --_section-padding-propagated.

A fixed-height card that really overflows and holds nothing tabbable becomes a tab stop (see STACK-06), so its scrolling content is reachable from the keyboard in every engine. Upstream leaves this to the browser.
